standard_prerequisites.name: The symbolic power of a prime ideal as the kernel of the map to the localized quotient, and the Mittag-Leffler condition for an inverse system of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Introduced in the author's section on Hartshorne-Lichtenbaum vanishing, where the counted statement occurs, and used at the start of the counted proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the objects of the statement and the criterion by which the proof controls the inverse system.

standard_prerequisites.name: Faithful flatness of the completion of a Noetherian local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 3715-3718
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the proof conclude from vanishing after completion that the element in question is already zero.

core_obligations: Reduce to an inverse system: the proof recalls the definition of the symbolic power and, by exactness of localization, obtains short exact sequences relating the ordinary quotients to the symbolic quotients, whose kernels are supported at the maximal ideal (proof lines 3702-3708)
Mittag-Leffler: since each of those kernels is an Artinian module over the local ring, the inverse system they form satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition (proof lines 3708-3710)

Pass to the limit and use faithful flatness: an element of the intersection of the symbolic powers maps to zero in the completion of the localization, and because the localization maps faithfully flatly into that completion the element itself is zero (proof lines 3712-3718)
Conclusion: the intersection of the symbolic powers is contained in every ordinary power for large index, which is the statement (proof line 3718)
proof_roadmap: 由局部化的正合性得短正合列 0 -> a_n -> A/p^n -> A/p^{(n)} -> 0，且 a_n 的支撑在 {m} 上，故 a_n 是 Artinian，逆系统 (a_n) 满足 Mittag-Leffler。
取落在所有符号幂交中的元素 f，它在 A_p 的完备化中为零；由 A_p -> A_p^ 忠实平坦得 f 在 A_p 中为零，A 是整环故 f = 0。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the eventual comparison between symbolic and ordinary powers of a height-one prime in a complete Noetherian local domain (author lemma at source lines 3693-3699, label lemma-inverse-system-symbolic-powers). The proof (source lines 3701-3719) runs through an inverse system: exactness of localization produces short exact sequences whose kernels are supported at the maximal ideal and hence Artinian, so the system is Mittag-Leffler (proof lines 3702-3710), and an element lying in every symbolic power is then shown to vanish by completing the localization and using faithful flatness (proof lines 3712-3718). The Mittag-Leffler step and the faithful-flatness conclusion are the two substantive moves. H2.
